plugins.name: wiki
plugins.description: Bootstrap a personal, LLM-maintained wiki for a single subject as an Obsidian vault — three folders, an index, a changelog, and a schema. Structure-only; no content is invented.

plugins.name: git
plugins.description: Solo-dev git shipping workflow — /git:ship stages everything, auto-writes a commit message from the diff, pushes the current branch, opens a PR into main, and auto-merges it. Refuses to run on main.
